description: Fresh processes on the same warm graph, with exact stdout checks. The primary comparison rotates five prebuilt executables. An independent three-executable run follows the four-runtime suite. Each interval is a 20,000-resample percentile bootstrap of the median within-round time ratio. Rejected batches are retained.

compiler_options.imre_lto: Same source, matching runtime compiled with -Clinker-plugin-lto and Imre --lto-linker
compiler_options.rust_lto: Same Rust source and system allocator, Cargo release with profile.release.lto=thin
